observation: control_transport::exchange accepts only owner, raw bytes, ConnectWork(deadline,token), optional confirmation. It compares owner/deadline/current token state, but has no expected identity or cancellation ID. Request::validate compares those only for business invocation variants; control wire IDs can change without affecting admission. Existing control fault test omits identity/cancellation-ID substitutions.
